result: I added `fill_rect` and `is_solid_at` to `scripts/level.gd`; I couldn't run Godot, so neither has been run. `fill_rect` sets every cell in the rect to tile (0, 0) of source 0, and `is_solid_at` converts the global position with `ground.to_local` and `local_to_map`, so it still works if the level or Ground moves.
